biography:
I empower organizations to build robust and scalable infrastructure portfolios by leading with transparency and authenticity, fostering strong partnerships internally and externally, and leveraging informed systems to drive strategic growth. I have direct experience in delivering 2 gigawatts of critical infrastructure development across data centers and utility scale solar as well as creating innovative solutions that optimize operations and deliver significant business value. My impact extends to coaching high-performing teams, and mentoring individuals indirectly related to my functional scope to foster inclusive and supportive organizational dynamics.
I am a creative, energetic professional with experience in the renewable energy and data center development industries. As a motivated individual, I have the proven ability to develop acquisition strategies and manage cross-functional teams see projects through their lifecycle using my excellent judgment and problem-solving skills. My experience shows a successful track record in both well-established and start-up office environments; always working with the team to achieve the best results. 

Specialties: Land acquisition, real estate development, entitlements, data center leasing, communication and project completion.
